      position: relative;
      width: min(100%, 560px);
      aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
      margin: 0 auto;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);
      background:

      box-shadow: inset 0 0 35px rgba(0,0,0,.4);

      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.12);

      left: 50%;
      top: 0;
      width: 1px;
      height: 100%;

      top: 50%;
      width: 100%;

            answer: "Custom item chosen by the parent: " + name + ". Decide what counts before starting, then accept reasonable kid observations.",

          };

    function chosenClues() {
      return allClues().filter(item => selectedIds.includes(item.id) || item.custom);
    }

      const library = $("library");

      clueBank.forEach(item => {
        const row = document.createElement("label");
        row.className = "library-row";
        row.innerHTML = `
          <input type="checkbox" value="${item.id}" ${selectedIds.includes(item.id) ? "checked" : ""}>
          <span><strong>${item.emoji} ${escapeHTML(item.title)}</strong><br>${escapeHTML(item.zone)} · ${escapeHTML(item.checklist)}</span>
        `;
        library.appendChild(row);
      });

      library.querySelectorAll("input[type='checkbox']").forEach(box => {
        box.addEventListener("change", () => {
          selectedIds = Array.from(library.querySelectorAll("input[type='checkbox']:checked")).map(input => input.value);
          saveState();
          buildHunt();
        });
      });
    }

    function buildExportText(chosen, title, date, sky, leader, difficulty) {
      const difficultyLabel = {
        little: "Little explorers",
        mixed: "Mixed ages",
        older: "Older kids"
      }[difficulty] || "Mixed ages";

      let text = "";
      text += title + "\n";
      text += "Date: " + date + "\n";
      text += "Kid level: " + difficultyLabel + "\n";
      text += "Sky note: " + sky + "\n";
      text += "Leader note: " + leader + "\n\n";

      text += "SIMPLE SKY MAP GUIDE\n";
      text += "====================\n";
      text += "Use north, east, south, and west as starting zones. These are search hints, not exact calculated positions.\n";
      text += "Scan from the horizon up toward overhead. If a target is hidden by clouds, trees, houses, or timing, mark it not visible tonight.\n\n";

      chosen.forEach((item, idx) => {
        text += (idx + 1) + ". " + item.title + " · Look zone: " + item.zone + "\n";
      });

      text += "\nKID CLUE CARDS\n";
      text += "==============\n";
      chosen.forEach((item, idx) => {
        text += (idx + 1) + ". " + item.emoji + " " + item.title + "\n";
        text += "Look zone: " + item.zone + "\n";
        text += "Clue: " + (item.clue[difficulty] || item.clue.mixed) + "\n";
        text += "Task: " + item.find + "\n\n";
      });

      text += "FINDER CHECKLIST\n";
      text += "================\n";
      chosen.forEach(item => {
        text += "[ ] " + item.checklist + " · " + item.zone + "\n";
      });

      text += "\nPARENT ANSWER KEY\n";
      text += "=================\n";
      text += "These are guide answers, not strict astronomy rules. Visibility depends on clouds, trees, light pollution, time, and direction.\n\n";
      chosen.forEach((item, idx) => {
        text += (idx + 1) + ". " + item.title + "\n";
        text += "Look zone: " + item.zone + "\n";
        text += "Answer: " + item.answer + "\n\n";
      });

      text += "Parent tip: If a clue is not visible, turn it into an observation question: Why might this be hard to see tonight?\n";

      return text;
    }

    function clearMapMarkers() {
      $("skyMap").querySelectorAll(".marker").forEach(marker => marker.remove());
      $("mapLegend").innerHTML = "";
    }

    function renderSkyMap(chosen) {
      clearMapMarkers();

      chosen.forEach((item, idx) => {
        const marker = document.createElement("div");
        marker.className = "marker";
        marker.style.left = item.mapX + "%";
        marker.style.top = item.mapY + "%";
        marker.textContent = idx + 1;
        marker.title = item.title + " · " + item.zone;
        $("skyMap").appendChild(marker);

        const legend = document.createElement("div");
        legend.className = "legend-item";
        legend.innerHTML = `

          <span><strong>${escapeHTML(item.title)}</strong><br>${escapeHTML(item.zone)}</span>
        `;
        $("mapLegend").appendChild(legend);
      });
    }

    function buildHunt() {
      const difficulty = getDifficulty();
      const title = $("huntTitle").value.trim() || "Tonight’s Backyard Sky Quest";
      const date = prettyDate($("huntDate").value);
      const sky = $("skyNote").value.trim() || "Backyard sky check.";
      const leader = $("leaderNote").value.trim() || "Let your eyes adjust and only search for what is visible tonight.";

      $("outTitle").textContent = title;
      $("outDate").textContent = date;
      $("outSky").textContent = sky;
      $("outLeader").textContent = leader;
      $("keyTitle").textContent = title;
      $("keyDate").textContent = date;

      const chosen = chosenClues();
      const cards = $("cards");
      const checklist = $("checklist");
      const answers = $("answers");

      cards.innerHTML = "";
      checklist.innerHTML = "";
      answers.innerHTML = "";

      if (!chosen.length) {
        clearMapMarkers();
        cards.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-state">Pick at least one clue card to build the hunt.</div>`;
        $("exportText").value = "";
        return;
      }

      renderSkyMap(chosen);

      chosen.forEach((item, idx) => {
        const card = document.createElement("article");
        card.className = "card";
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div>
            <div class="card-top">
              <h3>${idx + 1}. ${escapeHTML(item.title)}</h3>

            </div>
            <div class="look-zone">Look zone: ${escapeHTML(item.zone)}</div>
            <p class="clue">${escapeHTML(item.clue[difficulty] || item.clue.mixed)}</p>
          </div>
          <div class="find-line">${escapeHTML(item.find)}</div>
        `;
        cards.appendChild(card);

        const check = document.createElement("div");
        check.className = "check-item";
        check.innerHTML = `
          <span class="box"></span>
          <span>${escapeHTML(item.checklist)}<small>${escapeHTML(item.zone)}</small></span>
        `;
        checklist.appendChild(check);

        const answer = document.createElement("div");
        answer.className = "answer-item";
        answer.innerHTML = `
          <strong>${idx + 1}. ${escapeHTML(item.title)}</strong>
          <span class="answer-zone">Look zone: ${escapeHTML(item.zone)}</span>
          <div>${escapeHTML(item.answer)}</div>
        `;
        answers.appendChild(answer);
      });

      $("exportText").value = buildExportText(chosen, title, date, sky, leader, difficulty);

      saveState();
    }

    function saveState() {
      const state = {
        huntTitle: $("huntTitle").value,
        huntDate: $("huntDate").value,
        skyNote: $("skyNote").value,
        leaderNote: $("leaderNote").value,
        difficulty: $("difficulty").value,
        selectedIds,
        customClues
      };
      localStorage.setItem("stargazing-hunt-state", JSON.stringify(state));
    }

    function loadState() {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem("stargazing-hunt-state");
      if (!raw) {
        $("huntDate").value = todayForInput();
        return;
      }

      try {
        const state = JSON.parse(raw);
        $("huntTitle").value = state.huntTitle || "Tonight’s Backyard Sky Quest";
        $("huntDate").value = state.huntDate || todayForInput();
        $("skyNote").value = state.skyNote || "";
        $("leaderNote").value = state.leaderNote || "";
        $("difficulty").value = state.difficulty || "mixed";
        selectedIds = Array.isArray(state.selectedIds) ? state.selectedIds : selectedIds;
        customClues = Array.isArray(state.customClues) ? state.customClues : [];
      } catch {
        $("huntDate").value = todayForInput();
      }
    }

    function resetHunt() {
      localStorage.removeItem("stargazing-hunt-state");
      selectedIds = ["moon", "bright", "dipper", "north", "triangle", "colors", "satellite", "plane"];
      customClues = [];
      $("huntTitle").value = "Tonight’s Backyard Sky Quest";
      $("huntDate").value = todayForInput();
      $("difficulty").value = "mixed";
      $("skyNote").value = "Backyard. Look away from porch lights. Trees block part of the western sky.";
      $("leaderNote").value = "Use red or dim flashlights if you have them. Let your eyes adjust for 10 minutes. Not every clue needs to be visible tonight.";
      $("customItem").value = "";
      $("copyStatus").textContent = "";
      $("copyStatus2").textContent = "";
      renderLibrary();
      buildHunt();
    }

    function printMode(mode) {
      buildHunt();
      document.body.classList.remove("print-kids", "print-answer");
      document.body.classList.add(mode);
      window.print();
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.body.classList.remove("print-kids", "print-answer");
      }, 500);
    }

    async function copyExportText(statusId) {
      buildHunt();
      const text = $("exportText").value;
      const status = $(statusId);

      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        status.textContent = "Copied.";
      } catch {
        $("exportText").focus();
        $("exportText").select();
        const ok = document.execCommand("copy");
        status.textContent = ok ? "Copied." : "Select the text box and copy manually.";
      }

      setTimeout(() => {
        status.textContent = "";
      }, 2200);
    }

    $("buildBtn").addEventListener("click", buildHunt);
    $("printKidsBtn").addEventListener("click", () => printMode("print-kids"));
    $("printAnswerBtn").addEventListener("click", () => printMode("print-answer"));
    $("toolbarPrintKids").addEventListener("click", () => printMode("print-kids"));
    $("toolbarPrintAnswer").addEventListener("click", () => printMode("print-answer"));
    $("copyBtn").addEventListener("click", () => copyExportText("copyStatus"));
    $("copyBtn2").addEventListener("click", () => copyExportText("copyStatus2"));
    $("resetBtn").addEventListener("click", resetHunt);

    $("addCustom").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const value = $("customItem").value.trim();
      if (!value) return;
      customClues.push(value);
      $("customItem").value = "";
      buildHunt();
    });

    $("customItem").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter") {
        event.preventDefault();
        $("addCustom").click();
      }
    });

    ["huntTitle", "huntDate", "skyNote", "leaderNote", "difficulty"].forEach(id => {
      $(id).addEventListener("input", buildHunt);
      $(id).addEventListener("change", buildHunt);
    });

    loadState();
    renderLibrary();
    buildHunt();
  </script>
</body>

    let selectedIds = ["moon", "bright", "dipper", "north", "triangle", "colors", "satellite", "plane"];

    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

    function todayForInput() {

      const offset = now.getTimezoneOffset();
      const local = new Date(now.getTime() - offset * 60000);

    }

    function prettyDate(value) {
      if (!value) return "Tonight";
      const date = new Date(value + "T12:00:00");
      return date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
        weekday: "long",
        month: "long",
        day: "numeric",
        year: "numeric"
      });

    function escapeHTML(str) {
      return String(str)
        .replaceAll("&", "&")
        .replaceAll("<", "<")
        .replaceAll(">", ">")
        .replaceAll('"', """)
        .replaceAll("'", "'");

    function getDifficulty() {

    function customPosition(index) {

        { x: 68, y: 34, zone: "East or open sky" },
        { x: 60, y: 70, zone: "South or open sky" },
        { x: 32, y: 72, zone: "West or open sky" },
        { x: 50, y: 50, zone: "Overhead or open sky" }
      ];
      return positions[index % positions.length];

    function allClues() {
      return [
        ...clueBank,
        ...customClues.map((name, index) => {
          const pos = customPosition(index);
          return {
            id: "custom-" + index + "-" + name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ""),
            emoji: "⭐",
            title: name,
            checklist: name,
            zone: pos.zone,

        little: "Little explorers",
        mixed: "Mixed ages",
        older: "Older kids"
      }[difficulty] || "Mixed ages";

      let text = "";
      text += title + "\n";
      text += "Date: " + date + "\n";
      text += "Kid level: " + difficultyLabel + "\n";
      text += "Sky note: " + sky + "\n";
      text += "Leader note: " + leader + "\n\n";

      text += "ADULT SETUP CHECKLIST\n";
      text += "=====================\n";
      setupItems.forEach(item => {
        text += "[ ] " + item + "\n";
      });
      text += "\nCloud plan: If clouds roll in, switch to moving lights, cloud windows, moon shadows, night sounds, and why-can't-we-see-it observations.\n\n";

      text += "SIMPLE SKY MAP GUIDE\n";
      text += "====================\n";
      text += "Use north, east, south, and west as starting zones. These are search hints, not exact calculated positions.\n";
      text += "Scan from the horizon up toward overhead. If a target is hidden by clouds, trees, houses, or timing, mark it not visible tonight.\n\n";

      chosen.forEach((item, idx) => {
        text += (idx + 1) + ". " + item.title + " · Look zone: " + item.zone + "\n";
      });

      text += "\nKID CLUE CARDS\n";
      text += "==============\n";
      chosen.forEach((item, idx) => {
        text += (idx + 1) + ". " + item.emoji + " " + item.title + "\n";
        text += "Look zone: " + item.zone + "\n";
        text += "Clue: " + (item.clue[difficulty] || item.clue.mixed) + "\n";
        text += "Task: " + item.find + "\n\n";
      });

      text += "FINDER CHECKLIST\n";
      text += "================\n";
      chosen.forEach(item => {
        text += "[ ] " + item.checklist + " · " + item.zone + "\n";

      text += "=================\n";
      text += "These are guide answers, not strict astronomy rules. Visibility depends on clouds, trees, light pollution, time, and direction.\n\n";
      chosen.forEach((item, idx) => {
        text += (idx + 1) + ". " + item.title + "\n";
        text += "Look zone: " + item.zone + "\n";
        text += "Answer: " + item.answer + "\n\n";

      return text;
    }

    function clearMapMarkers() {
      $("skyMap").querySelectorAll(".marker").forEach(marker => marker.remove());
      $("mapLegend").innerHTML = "";
    }

    function renderSkyMap(chosen) {
      clearMapMarkers();

      chosen.forEach((item, idx) => {
        const marker = document.createElement("div");
        marker.className = "marker";
        marker.style.left = item.mapX + "%";
        marker.style.top = item.mapY + "%";
        marker.textContent = idx + 1;
        marker.title = item.title + " · " + item.zone;
        $("skyMap").appendChild(marker);

        const legend = document.createElement("div");
        legend.className = "legend-item";
        legend.innerHTML = `
          <span class="legend-num">${idx + 1}</span>
          <span><strong>${escapeHTML(item.title)}</strong><br>${escapeHTML(item.zone)}</span>
        `;
        $("mapLegend").appendChild(legend);
      });
    }

        row.innerHTML = `

          <span>${escapeHTML(item.checklist)}<small>${escapeHTML(item.zone)}</small></span>

        checklist.appendChild(check);

        answer.className = "answer-item";
        answer.innerHTML = `

          <span class="answer-zone">Look zone: ${escapeHTML(item.zone)}</span>
          <div>${escapeHTML(item.answer)}</div>
        `;
        answers.appendChild(answer);
      });

      $("exportText").value = buildExportText(chosen, title, date, sky, leader, difficulty);

      saveState();
    }

    function saveState() {
      const state = {
        huntTitle: $("huntTitle").value,
        huntDate: $("huntDate").value,
        skyNote: $("skyNote").value,
        leaderNote: $("leaderNote").value,
        difficulty: $("difficulty").value,
        selectedIds,
        customClues
      };
      localStorage.setItem("stargazing-hunt-state", JSON.stringify(state));
    }

    function loadState() {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem("stargazing-hunt-state");
      if (!raw) {
        $("huntDate").value = todayForInput();
        return;
      }

      try {
        const state = JSON.parse(raw);
        $("huntTitle").value = state.huntTitle || "Tonight’s Backyard Sky Quest";
        $("huntDate").value = state.huntDate || todayForInput();
        $("skyNote").value = state.skyNote || "";
        $("leaderNote").value = state.leaderNote || "";
        $("difficulty").value = state.difficulty || "mixed";
        selectedIds = Array.isArray(state.selectedIds) ? state.selectedIds : selectedIds;
        customClues = Array.isArray(state.customClues) ? state.customClues : [];
      } catch {
        $("huntDate").value = todayForInput();
      }
    }

    function resetHunt() {
      localStorage.removeItem("stargazing-hunt-state");
      selectedIds = ["moon", "bright", "dipper", "north", "triangle", "colors", "satellite", "plane"];
      customClues = [];
      $("huntTitle").value = "Tonight’s Backyard Sky Quest";
      $("huntDate").value = todayForInput();
      $("difficulty").value = "mixed";
      $("skyNote").value = "Backyard. Look away from porch lights. Trees block part of the western sky.";
      $("leaderNote").value = "Use red or dim flashlights if you have them. Let your eyes adjust for 10 minutes. Not every clue needs to be visible tonight.";
      $("customItem").value = "";
      $("copyStatus").textContent = "";
      $("copyStatus2").textContent = "";
      renderLibrary();
      buildHunt();
    }

    function loadSampleNight() {
      selectedIds = ["moon", "bright", "dipper", "north", "triangle", "colors", "satellite", "plane", "cloud", "quiet"];
      customClues = ["porch light glow", "favorite constellation shape"];

      $("huntTitle").value = "Sample Backyard Star Quest";
      $("huntDate").value = todayForInput();
      $("difficulty").value = "mixed";
      $("skyNote").value = "Sample backyard night. Face away from porch lights. North is near the back fence. Trees block part of the west. The clearest view is east and overhead.";
      $("leaderNote").value = "Start with 10 quiet seconds, then scan one direction at a time. If clouds roll in, switch to cloud windows, moving lights, moon shadows, and night sounds.";

      renderLibrary();
      buildHunt();
      $("copyStatus").textContent = "Sample night loaded.";
      setTimeout(() => {
        $("copyStatus").textContent = "";
      }, 2200);
    }

    function printMode(mode) {
      buildHunt();
      document.body.classList.remove("print-kids", "print-answer");
      document.body.classList.add(mode);
      window.print();
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.body.classList.remove("print-kids", "print-answer");
      }, 500);
    }

    async function copyExportText(statusId) {
      buildHunt();
      const text = $("exportText").value;
      const status = $(statusId);

      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        status.textContent = "Copied.";
      } catch {
        $("exportText").focus();
        $("exportText").select();
        const ok = document.execCommand("copy");
        status.textContent = ok ? "Copied." : "Select the text box and copy manually.";
      }

      setTimeout(() => {
        status.textContent = "";
      }, 2200);
    }

    $("sampleBtn").addEventListener("click", loadSampleNight);
    $("buildBtn").addEventListener("click", buildHunt);
    $("printKidsBtn").addEventListener("click", () => printMode("print-kids"));
    $("printAnswerBtn").addEventListener("click", () => printMode("print-answer"));
    $("toolbarPrintKids").addEventListener("click", () => printMode("print-kids"));

    $("copyBtn").addEventListener("click", () => copyExportText("copyStatus"));
    $("copyBtn2").addEventListener("click", () => copyExportText("copyStatus2"));
    $("resetBtn").addEventListener("click", resetHunt);

    $("addCustom").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const value = $("customItem").value.trim();
      if (!value) return;
      customClues.push(value);
      $("customItem").value = "";
      buildHunt();
    });

    $("customItem").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter") {
        event.preventDefault();
        $("addCustom").click();
      }
    });

    ["huntTitle", "huntDate", "skyNote", "leaderNote", "difficulty"].forEach(id => {
      $(id).addEventListener("input", buildHunt);
      $(id).addEventListener("change", buildHunt);
    });

    loadState();
    renderLibrary();
    buildHunt();
  </script>
</body>

    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

    function todayForInput() {
      const now = new Date();
      const offset = now.getTimezoneOffset();
      const local = new Date(now.getTime() - offset * 60000);
      return local.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    }

    function prettyDate(value) {
      if (!value) return "Tonight";
      const date = new Date(value + "T12:00:00");
      return date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
        weekday: "long",
        month: "long",
        day: "numeric",
        year: "numeric"
      });
    }

    function escapeHTML(str) {
      return String(str)
        .replaceAll("&", "&")
        .replaceAll("<", "<")
        .replaceAll(">", ">")
        .replaceAll('"', """)
        .replaceAll("'", "'");
    }

    function getDifficulty() {
      return $("difficulty").value || "mixed";
    }

    function customPosition(index) {
      const positions = [
        { x: 24, y: 32, zone: "Northwest or open sky" },
        { x: 68, y: 34, zone: "East or open sky" },
        { x: 60, y: 70, zone: "South or open sky" },
        { x: 32, y: 72, zone: "West or open sky" },
        { x: 50, y: 50, zone: "Overhead or open sky" }
      ];
      return positions[index % positions.length];
    }

    function allClues() {
      return [
        ...clueBank,
        ...customClues.map((name, index) => {
          const pos = customPosition(index);
          return {
            id: "custom-" + index + "-" + name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ""),
            emoji: "⭐",
            title: name,
            checklist: name,
            zone: pos.zone,
            mapX: pos.x,
            mapY: pos.y,
            clue: {
              little: "Find this special item: " + name + ". Start in the map zone and ask a grownup for a hint if you need one.",
              mixed: "Find this custom sky item: " + name + ". Start in the suggested zone, then record where you saw it.",
              older: "Find this custom target: " + name + ". Start in the suggested zone and note what helped you identify it."
            },
            find: "Write where you found it.",
            answer: "Custom item chosen by the parent: " + name + ". Decide what counts before starting, then accept reasonable kid observations.",
            custom: true
          };
        })
      ];
    }

    function chosenClues() {
      return allClues().filter(item => selectedIds.includes(item.id) || item.custom);
    }

        row.innerHTML = `
          <input type="checkbox" value="${item.id}" ${selectedIds.includes(item.id) ? "checked" : ""}>
          <span class="library-copy"><strong>${item.emoji} ${escapeHTML(item.title)}</strong>${escapeHTML(item.zone)} · ${escapeHTML(item.checklist)}</span>
        `;
        library.appendChild(row);
      });

      library.querySelectorAll("input[type='checkbox']").forEach(box => {
        box.addEventListener("change", () => {
          selectedIds = Array.from(library.querySelectorAll("input[type='checkbox']:checked")).map(input => input.value);
          saveState();
          buildHunt();
        });
      });
    }

      checklist.innerHTML = "";

      renderSetupChecklist();

        clearMapMarkers();
        cards.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-state">Pick at least one clue card to build the hunt.</div>`;
        $("exportText").value = "";

        huntTitle: $("huntTitle").value,
        huntDate: $("huntDate").value,
        skyNote: $("skyNote").value,
        leaderNote: $("leaderNote").value,
        difficulty: $("difficulty").value,
        selectedIds,
        customClues
      };
      localStorage.setItem("stargazing-hunt-state", JSON.stringify(state));
    }

    function loadState() {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem("stargazing-hunt-state");
      if (!raw) {
        $("huntDate").value = todayForInput();
        return;
      }

      try {
        const state = JSON.parse(raw);
        $("huntTitle").value = state.huntTitle || "Tonight’s Backyard Sky Quest";
        $("huntDate").value = state.huntDate || todayForInput();
        $("skyNote").value = state.skyNote || "";
        $("leaderNote").value = state.leaderNote || "";
        $("difficulty").value = state.difficulty || "mixed";
        selectedIds = Array.isArray(state.selectedIds) ? state.selectedIds : selectedIds;
        customClues = Array.isArray(state.customClues) ? state.customClues : [];
      } catch {
        $("huntDate").value = todayForInput();
      }
    }
